displayName: OCI-WSTG01-001: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Content
description:
Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: search engine discovery of sensitive content

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_001", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0
